title: 「死の商人国家だ」左派、中国反発も…友好国は歓迎　抑止力高める武器輸出緩和は平和の道
extracted_text: 日本政府は4月21日、防衛装備品の輸出ルールを定めた防衛装備移転三原則と運用指針を改定した。完成品の輸出を非戦闘目的に限る「5類型」（救難、輸送、警戒、監視、掃海）を撤廃し、戦闘機や護衛艦など殺傷能力のある武器の輸出を原則可能にした。政府は三木武夫内閣だった昭和51年以降、厳しく制限してきた。 こうした防衛政策の転換に左派勢力らは否定的な声を上げた。共産党機関紙「しんぶん赤旗」は4月22日の記事で「高市早苗政権は『平和国家』の理念に基づいて定めていた武器輸出禁止の原則を跡形もなく消し去り、『死の商人国家』への道を突き進もうとしています」と論評した。 武器輸出の歴史に詳しい東大の小野塚知二特任教授は22日付朝日新聞で「誰もが憲法9条の縛りを感じ、暗黙のうちに殺傷能力のある兵器の輸出はダメだと考える強い規範が働いてきた」と指摘。その上で「今回の改定は、9条の縛りを事実上外す、大きな政策変更だ」と批判的に論じた。
translated_text: On April 21, the Japanese government revised the Three Principles on Transfer of Defense Equipment and their implementation guidelines. The government abolished the "five non-combat categories" — rescue, transport, surveillance, monitoring, and minesweeping — which had restricted the export of finished defense products to non-combative purposes, and made the export of lethal weapons such as fighter jets and destroyers原则上 possible. The government had maintained strict restrictions on such exports since the Takeo Miki cabinet in 1976. Left-wing forces voiced opposition to this defense policy shift. The Communist Party newspaper Shimbun Akahata commented on April 22: "The Sanna administration is erasing without a trace the principle of banning arms exports that had been established on the basis of the 'peaceful nation' ideal, and is pressing full speed ahead toward becoming a 'merchant of death' nation." Professor Tomoji Onozuka of the University of Tokyo, an expert on the history of arms exports, pointed out in the Asahi Shimbun on April 22: "Everyone has felt the constraints of Article 9 of the Constitution, and a strong norm has been at work that implicitly prohibited the export of lethal weapons." He went on to criticize: "This revision is a major policy change that effectively removes the constraints of Article 9."
title_en: Left-wing Forces Call Japan 'Merchant of Death' as China Opposes, Allied Nations Welcome It — Easing Arms Exports to Boost Deterrence Is a Path to Peace
